description:
I am Griffin Lewis, the creator of HydraQuench, a product that helps people live healthier lives by staying hydrated in a more effective way.

I have always been active and have run many marathons and races. I know the importance of staying hydrated, and have always felt there had to be a better way to hydrate than chugging down a bunch of bottles of water.

So my two year journey began…. Researching hydration, reading, talking to experts, and analyzing products in the market.  What I found was fillers, sugar, calories, and at the most, maybe some vitamin B-12.  I expected better.

I wanted HydraQuench to have all natural ingredients with nothing artificial. That is why we use:

  • Elderberry – Packed with antioxidants.
  • Echinacea – Boosts the immune system.
  • Vitamin B-12 – Supports brain function and blood flow.
  • Electrolytes – Keeps the body hydrated.
  • Plus beet root, potassium, magnesium, L-glutamine, and Himalayan sea salt.
  • And its gluten free, no sugar or calories, lab tested, and NSF certified.

With HydraQuench you do not have to drink as much water to stay hydrated plus no tablets or powders.

And it’s not just for athletes!  According to clinical studies, 75% of people are not as hydrated as they should be. It is no wonder they are experiencing headaches, fatigue, weakness, high heart rate, or muscle cramps.  

I knew by packing HydraQuench full of natural ingredients, there would be multiple benefits including a big one …..Recovery.

If you are short on sleep, need to study for a test, stayed out late, or just want to be more alert, HydraQuench is the best natural way to feel better!

We are always looking for new solutions
